criteria: High-quality = (1) a solid public GitHub repository, and (2) strong results versus previous methods. Auto-refreshed daily.

image.title: RNSIDNet: Generalized Synthetic Image Detection with Enhanced RGB-Noise Representation Learning
image.summary: Dual-branch detector: an attention-refined CLIP RGB stream that dynamically modulates a Bayar-convolution high-frequency noise stream via a FiLM module, trained with Hard Sample-aware Contrastive Learning (HSCL). Semantic + low-level artifact fusion in the same family as Co-Spy/AIDE.
image.result: Claims SOTA generalization/robustness/efficiency across 8 benchmarks (paper; no per-benchmark numbers in the abstract). [RULE 1 pending: the promised repo github.com/multimediaFor/RNSIDNet is 404 as of 2026-07-08 ('code and dataset will be publicly available', not yet up). Retained as a strong trending pre-print; PRUNE per the ~3-day policy if the repo stays unavailable.]

image.title: PGC: Peak-Guided Calibration for AI-Generated Image Detection
image.summary: LoRA-tuned DINOv2 RGB stream + a YCbCr-quantization-residual CNN, fused by a peak-guided (log-sum-exp) calibration. Strong cross-generator transfer.

image.title: PROBE: Probing Generative Space for Generalizable AIGI Detection
image.summary: Boosts cross-generator generalization by augmenting training with images sampled from probed generative-space variations; the detector is a fine-tuned DINOv2 (sliding-patch) classifier. Released weights on ModelScope.
image.result: PROBE-DINOv2 93.9% avg balanced-acc over 7 benchmarks (paper). AGID reproduces the official weights: GenImage 98.54 / Synthbuster 99.27 / UFD 95.95 mAP (mAUROC 96-99). [Integration on branch trending/probe, under review.]

image.title: DiCoME: Divide-and-Conquer Multi-View Evidential Learning for Deepfake Detection
image.summary: Disentangles semantic vs structural-artifact views and fuses them with evidential learning to counter the 'semantic masking effect'. Released checkpoint (HF).
image.result: SOTA cross-dataset deepfake generalization (DeepfakeBench protocol). [face-deepfake domain; AGID lacks those datasets locally — integration pending data.]

image.title: Images as Tables: In-Context AIGI Detection with TabPFN
image.summary: Frozen DINOv3 CLS feature -> PCA(500) -> TabPFN in-context tabular classification; strong few-shot/low-data generalization with no task-specific training.
image.result: Generalizable detection in the low-data regime (few labeled examples per new generator). [integration pending: in-context TabPFN paradigm — a clean AGID forward->logit needs the released fitted TabPFN+PCA+labeled-support-set checkpoint baked in (GDrive), plus an external version-sensitive tabpfn dependency; a different paradigm from the trained-detector template, and the headline is a low-data/few-shot niche (multi-multi acc 0.8765 / AUROC 0.9501 @625 samples) rather than full-data SOTA. Verified repo 2026-06-20: weights on GDrive, frozen DINOv3->PCA(500)->TabPFN.]

image.title: Co-Spy: Fusing Semantic and Artifact Cues for Synthetic Image Detection
image.summary: Adaptive fusion of a SigLIP semantic stream and an SD-VAE artifact-residual stream.
image.result: Co-Spy-Bench ~96 mAP; AGID retrain reaches 96.6 (beats released weights on that bench).

image.title: SAFE: High-Frequency Artifact Detector with Targeted Augmentation
image.summary: Lightweight DWT high-frequency artifact detector with a carefully designed augmentation recipe.
image.result: AGID-trained reproduction (served): ForenSynths-8 97.79 / UFD-8 98.44 / GenImage-8 99.51 / DiTFake 99.96 mAP — beats the official checkpoint on GenImage.

image.title: AIDE: ConvNeXt Semantic + Low-Level DCT/SRM Cues
image.summary: Fuses ConvNeXt semantic features with low-level DCT/SRM frequency cues; native-resolution preprocessing.

image.title: SPAI: Spectral AI-Image Detection (any-resolution)
image.summary: Spectral Reconstruction Similarity + Spectral Context Attention; detects at native/arbitrary resolution.
image.result: AGID serves the official weights at native resolution (the faithful any-res path): GenImage 94.22 / Synthbuster 96.75 mAP — reproduces & beats the vendored-official 91.33.

image.title: FatFormer: Forgery-Aware Adaptive Transformer
image.summary: Frozen CLIP + forgery-aware adapters + learnable text-prompt context.

image.title: NPR: Neighboring-Pixel Relationships
image.summary: Small ResNet on neighboring-pixel residuals that expose generator up-sampling artifacts.

image.title: UnivFD / CLIP: Towards Universal Fake Image Detectors
image.summary: Linear probe on frozen CLIP ViT-L/14 features — a simple, strong cross-generator baseline.

video.title: D3: Disentangled Detail Dynamics (training-free)
video.summary: Training-free: 2nd-order std of frozen per-frame features as the score.
video.result: GenVideo-Val ~98 mAP (paper). AGID faithful protocol (X-CLIP-B/16 + 10% edge-crop): AUROC 95.95 / acc 91.7 (the paper's mAP isn't comparable on AGID's 10000:56 real:fake pool — AUROC is the robust metric).

video.title: ReStraV: Representation-Trajectory Geometry
video.summary: Frozen DINOv2 trajectory-geometry features + a standardized MLP head.

video.title: STALL: Spatio-Temporal whitened Log-Likelihoods (training-free)
video.summary: Training-free spatial + temporal whitened-Gaussian log-likelihoods vs a real-video calibration.

video.title: ATSS: Anomalous Temporal Self-Similarity for AI-Generated Video Detection
video.summary: Multimodal detector that exploits anomalous temporal self-similarity fingerprints across frames of AI-generated video. Inference code + a pretrained checkpoint (best.pt) are released; the data sampling/extraction pipeline is still being cleaned for release.
video.result: Claims SOTA in AP/AUC/ACC over GenVideo, EvalCrafter, VideoPhy, and VidProM vs prior methods (e.g. DeMamba). Repo live 2026-06-21 with code+weights; per-generator numbers not yet in the README. [integration pending: the released checkpoint's forward() consumes PRECOMPUTED multimodal temporal-self-similarity tensors (sim_img/sim_txt/sim_cross, BLIP2-based), not raw video — and the feature-extraction/data-sampling front-end that produces them is 'still being cleaned for release (coming soon)'. AGID feeds raw video clips, so there is no faithful way to run ATSS until that pipeline is published; will revisit when released.]

video.title: G2VD: Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection via Counterfactual Intervention and Causal Disentanglement
video.summary: Counterfactual-intervention + causal-disentanglement detector: a training-time CFIPipeline synthesizes controlled counterfactual samples (VAEs + frequency/pixel alignment), and a causal-disentanglement classifier with two domain-anchored branches and an HSIC independence constraint isolates the generalizable artifact signal from domain-specific content.
video.result: GenVidBench cross-domain: >90% accuracy / AUC ~0.95 using only 10% of the training data (paper). Repo live 2026-07-07 (CLIP/XCLIP/DeMamba backbones — the same family as AGID's D3). [integration pending (assessed 2026-07-07): (1) pretrained weights are NOT released — 'checkpoints will be listed in MODEL_ZOO.md once released'; and (2) the repo's test.py inference uses the CFIPipeline VAE-pool at eval time, not a single forward pass on a raw clip. Both fail the ADD_DETECTOR gate (need official weights + a clean forward->logit). Promising for later: standard CLIP/XCLIP backbone, so if weights drop AND the deployed path is just backbone+causal-branch classifier, it becomes integratable — re-checked 2026-07-08: MODEL_ZOO.md now exists but all 4 variants are still 'Coming soon' (no download links) — stays pending; will revisit when weights actually drop.]
